narrative.overview: The brand site that is the brand. It enforces the Giga design system by embodying it. The personality is institutional precision warmed by mission: a calm, generous, white-space-led baseline that comes alive with two things only, Giga Blue and real photography of connected classrooms. The blue is the voice; the photography is the reason. Density is low and deliberate; layout alternates centered intros with left-aligned, asymmetric content. Motion is choreographed but restrained. It rejects clutter and 'too much': no decorative illustration spam, no rainbow of accents, no black slabs, no gradient-text or glassmorphism, no SaaS hype.
keyCharacteristics: One voice color (Giga Blue) over a tinted near-white canvas, no second accent.
Real classroom/connectivity photography for warmth, used sparingly, never as wallpaper.
Manrope headlines with tight tracking; Open Sans body; generous whitespace.
Soft Stripe-grade shadows on flat surfaces; depth is a response to state.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Giga Blue is the only color that may fill a background. There is no secondary accent. Variety comes from blue tints (#EAF2FF to #0050E6) and from photography, not from new hues.

rules.name: The No-Black Rule
rules.body: Solid black or Grey-950 backgrounds are forbidden everywhere except Giga Maps. Dark areas are a real photograph or the neutral #0A0A0C scrim over a photograph, never a flat black panel.

rules.name: The No-Yellow Rule
rules.body: Reference layouts may use a yellow/lime accent; we do not. CTAs and accents are Giga Blue.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Every section opens with a Giga-Blue uppercase 10px eyebrow, then the headline, then one line of muted body. Reuse on every page.

rules.name: The Tight-Headline Rule
rules.body: Headlines always carry negative letter-spacing (-0.03em to -0.04em) and weight 600. Never set a headline at default tracking or below 500.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Hover Rule
rules.body: Cards rest flat with shadow-stripe. On hover they rise via .hover-lift and deepen to shadow-stripe-md. Elevation is a response to state, never a default.

rules.name: The Constant-Logo Rule
rules.body: The logo lockup and its width never change between header states; only its color flips. No size jump on scroll.

dos: Do lead every section with the eyebrow + headline + one-line body pattern, eyebrow in Giga Blue uppercase 10px.
Do keep Giga Blue (#277AFF) as the single voice; build variety from its tints and from photography.
Do keep surfaces flat with shadow-stripe; reserve lift and shadow-stripe-md for hover/state.
Do use real, on-mission photography for hero and a few feature tiles, with a neutral #0A0A0C scrim when text sits on top.
Do set headlines in Manrope 600 with negative tracking; body in Open Sans at ~15px, measure capped near 65ch.
Do keep motion choreographed but quiet, all prefers-reduced-motion safe.
Do prefer removing over adding. Balance, elegance, cleanliness.
donts: Don't use any background color other than Giga Blue. No second accent, no yellow/lime.
Don't place a solid black or Grey-950 background anywhere outside Giga Maps.
Don't fill tiles with decorative illustration SVGs, and don't let photo/color tiles outnumber the calm white ones.
Don't use gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, or glowing/'magical AI' SaaS styling.
Don't use em dashes in copy.
Don't let the connectivity colors (green/amber/red) become decorative; they are status/data only.
Don't change logo size between header states, and don't reintroduce a floating pill header.
